notes.title: Optimized achievement experiences and storyline experiences.
notes.content:
Adjusted the achievement condition for the assembly line mini-game - now achievable with a defect rate below 20%.
Modified the storyline of Dongfang Handan in Chapter 2.

notes.title: Add random mouse image
notes.content: When you start game every time,you will get a random mouse image,but you can also input"["or"]"to chose image you like.

notes.title: Added compensation mechanism
notes.content: Added a letter writing mini-game compensation mechanism to prevent players from getting stuck

notes.title: Fix some bug
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the text box required an additional click to appear after hiding the log.
Fixed a bug where continuously holding the fast-forward button and clicking the screen would repeatedly play chapter animations.

notes.title: Adjusted the achievement requirements:
notes.content:
- Changed the [Breakthrough Inner Demons] achievement to "Complete within 8 seconds to obtain"
- Modified the [Divination Master] achievement to "Perform divination 20 times to obtain"

notes.title: Fix some bad bugs
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where players could access the record interface in mini-games but couldn't close it.
Fixed an issue where closing the history log dialog during choice selection would cause it to unexpectedly reappear.
Fixed the problem in Chapter 2's pop-up window mini-game where the dialog box would appear outside the screen boundaries.
Removed the countdown timer from the Chapter 4 park mini-game.
Fixed various text-related issues and character sprite display bugs.

notes.title: Difficulty reduction
notes.content:
Considering feedback from many players about getting stuck at certain levels, we have appropriately reduced the difficulty of the pop-up mini-game and the pipeline mini-game. Thank you for your valuable feedback.

Additionally, we have added a new feature where scrolling up with the mouse wheel will bring up the log menu.
